description: This PHP source file defines the 'EmploymentContractAPI' class, which provides REST API endpoints to retrieve and update employment contract information for employees within the OrangeHRM system. It handles operations such as getting an employment contract, updating contract dates, and managing contract attachments, including replacing, deleting, or keeping current attachments.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee employment contract data, including fetching and updating contracts and their attachments.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the employment contract for a specified employee based on employee number.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates employment contract details, including dates and attachments, for a specified employee.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Lazily loads and returns the EmploymentContractService instance used for database operations.

methods.name: updateEmploymentContract
methods.description: Updates or creates an employment contract record with specified start and end dates.

methods.name: updateContractAttachment
methods.description: Handles the logic to add, replace, or delete a contract attachment.

methods.name: setAttachmentAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes of an EmployeeAttachment object based on a Base64Attachment object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' API operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'update' API operation, including date validation and attachment conditions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for contract deletion.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended for delete validation rules.
